i.norm:
Verifies that {@link CharSetUtils#count(String, String...)} counts how many characters of the input string belong to the supplied character set.

Here the set is built from the same string as the input. The set is interpreted with set-syntax (see {@link CharSet}), so the 13-character input yields a count of 12.
The set array holds the input string in its first slot; the remaining null entries are ignored by count().
